text.en: This Order may be cited as the Merchant Shipping )Amendment) Order, of section 2 of S 27/2002

Section 2 of the Merchant Shipping Order, 2002, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection 111 - fa} by inserting the following new definition immediately after the definition of ··master'' - " "Merchant Shipping Notice" means a notice described as such and issued by the Director pursuant to section 208A in such as he may detern1ine;"; fbi by deleting the definition of "Minister" and by substituting the new definition therefor - the of and Infocon1munications;". of new section 208A

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 208 - Shipping Notices 208A. Ill Subject to the provision of this Order, the Director may issue Merchant Shipping Notices in respect of administrative or technical matters relating to merchant shipping, navigation and safety as may be necessary for the purposes of this Order. 121 The Director may, in the Merchant Shipping Notice, prescribe that any provision of that Notice shall be applicable to any specified person or ship, or class of ships. j3) Any regulations relating to merchant shipping, navigation and safety made under this Order may provide that non·compliance with the Merchant Shipping Notice shall be an offence.". Made this 25th. day of Zulkaedah, 1442 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of July, 2021 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DHERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
